name: Sonic Slap
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

Your hand itself transmits sonic vibrations to the target upon a mere touch. This spell deals 1d6 sonic damage upon making a successful melee touch attack.
